items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: The Browns, Mr. and Mrs. Brown ran that place. That was quite a place, and they had very good entertainment.

ctx.x: And -- well, I don't know about any other -- I'm sure there were other after hours places on the avenue.

There were other places. There was a place down at 54th and Central Avenue, and that was called -- oh, Brown's, the Brown House, or something we called it. The Browns, Mr. and Mrs. Brown ran that place. That was quite a place, and they had very good entertainment. They had a regular group that played there, and as I say, people used to jam and sing. Vocalists -- people used to love to go there because they could sing, you know. They'd get a chance to sing along with these good groups.
Was that before or after hours, or both?
